One box for the sun, the battery and the car. SigenStor 5-in-1.

Rygol fits Sigenergy’s SigenStor: solar inverter, EV DC charger, battery power conversion, battery module and energy management in a single unit. With the Sigen Energy Gateway, the house switches to backup power when the grid goes down.

  • IP66, install anywhere
  • 100% depth of discharge
  • 5-layer battery safety
  • mySigen app monitoring

Approved, insured, guaranteed.

NICEIC approved company. A rewire ends with a full NICEIC inspection and a certificate to BS 7671 that is recognised by building departments, with a 6 year warranty on all works.

Risk assessments and method statements are provided before work starts. Finance, extended warranties and installation within 4 weeks are listed on Rygol’s solar pages.
